Team —

Quick reminder: this Friday is the formal revenue forecast submission deadline for Q3 planning. We have a 3:00 PM precall planned to triage any last-minute asks and confirm commit signals before I lock numbers into the sheet. Please come prepared with the following: 

- Updated stage (MQL/SQL/Proposal/PO) for each commitable account in your pipeline row
- Confidence score (1-5) and the rationale (1 sentence)
- Adjusted ACV and expected close date if changed this week

I've attached the intake template and a current commit_matrix.csv export from CRM — use those to update. On the precall we'll: 

1) Walk any deals flagged as "at-risk" (confidence <=2) — owner explains mitigation
2) Authoritatively mark any "soft-commit" deals that need to be excluded
3) Confirm final ACV numbers for submission

External note: Acme procurement and Lina will be on the line for a quick alignment on timing and any PO gating items. Please avoid bringing unrelated pipeline asks into the meeting — we'll handle those in follow-ups.

Attachments: forecast_intake_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), commit_matrix.csv (csv)

Thanks — see you at 3.

--
Marissa Cole
Manager, Revenue Operations
